sections.heading: International Activities
sections.html:
The teachers of the Department have participated in several international projects.

Joint Projects of Ministry of Education and the British Council of Ukraine

  • 1998-2001 Preparing Practical English Curriculum For Universities that Educate Teachers of English (N. Tuchyna, I. Kamynin)
  • 1999-2002 Developing the Course of Upgrading Skills of English Schoolteachers in Ukraine (N. Tuchyna)
  • 2005 – 2007 Assessment, Testing and Developing Testing Tasks (I. Kamynin, O. Ukrainska)
  • 2013 – 2019 New Generation English Schoolteacher (N. Tuchyna, I. Kamynin)
  • 2023 Teaching English in a New Context (L. Krasovitska)
  • 2021-2022 Project with the Consortium for Enhancement of Ukrainian Management Education supported by the USA Embassy “Pre-Service English Teacher Methodology Program” (H. Krapivnyk, N. Tuchyna)
  • Researchers at Risk program (2-Year Research and studies in Great Britain) financed by the Royal Academy and CARA foundation (M. Bielova, Birmingham University, UK, 2002-2004; O. Ukrainska, Lancaster University, UK, 2003-2005).
  • The Scholars at Risk, financed by European Association for American Studies (T. Starostenko, 2-month studies at the University of Novi Sad, Serbia, writing a manual on American Literature, which is now released).
  • NexusLinguarum (European network for Web-centred linguistic data science), financed by EC (Yu.Shpak from 2022 to 2024)
  • CA22115 - A Multilingual Repository of Phraseme Constructions in Central and Eastern European Languages (Yu. Shpak from 2023 to 2027)
  • CAPAS, 2-month grant for Research fellowship at the University of Heidelberg, Centre of Apocalypsis and Post-Apocalypsis Studies (G. Krapivnyk)
  • Access (USA socially directed project for Ukrainian teenagers), 2025, G. Krapivnyk
  • PAELT (Professional Association of English Teachers in Ukraine), financed by Hornby Fund (7 teachers from the department in 2024-2025.
  • Еразмус+ КА220, PERFECT (in partnership with Tartu University of Applied Medical Studies, Estonia, Bukovyna Medical University, Chernivtsi, Ukraine, Primorska University, Slovenia, and University of Rijeka, Croatia) from December 2024 to December 2027, improving training of healthcare educators and nurses (N. Tuchyna, G. Krapivnyk)
  • Еразмус+ AMUSE» (17 partner Universities) Developing Alternative Communication (G. Krapivnyk)
  • Еразмус+ LECTURE (18 partner Universities) Introducing European Standards into Teacher Education (G. Krapivnyk)
  • EAR Mentoring, financed by University of Warwick та Economic and Social Research Council, UK. Partners – PAELT, N.V. Gogol Nizhyn State Pedagogical University, and P. Tychyna Uman State Pedagogical University. From August 2025 to April 2026. N. Tuchyna, L. Krasovytska.
